summary: 20 cases, IDs Z01-Z20, split holdout_v6, request {} in all; mix 4 market_event, 3 forecast (2 as-of), 3 document, 5 notice, 2 ambiguous_unavailable (1 clarification, 1 refusal), 2 adversarial, 1 injection; 6 unused (Z04 TAS1-2026-07-29 and the 5 notice cases on pool notices, 1 routine price review), 14 familiar with event material from listed events. All row-backed gold values matched their source rows within tolerance; all counts are window-convention-independent; all snippets verbatim.

cases.checks: Unused region-day: 288 TAS1 intervals with interval_end in (2026-07-28T14:00Z, 2026-07-29T14:00Z]. Day max RRP row (10:05Z = 20:05 Hobart) and day max TOTALDEMAND row (2026-07-28T21:55Z = 07:55 Hobart) re-derived; both rows lie inside the day; same rows under the alternative [14:00Z,14:00Z) convention; no ties (runners-up 122.64 $/MWh and 1362.37 MW). Confirmed 0 intervals >= 300 on the day. Group TAS1-2026-07-29, stratum unused, question does not signal novelty.
cases.note: Writer flag checked: no high-price interval that day, so gold = the day's maximums, which the question asks for; acceptable under the brief (market_event case 'on TAS1's unused day'). The day does contain 46 RRP<0 (low-price) intervals, so the market_event_review intent still has a qualifying interval; the question does not ask about them. 'TAS1 total demand' is read as TOTALDEMAND (regionsum); the operational-demand peak is a different measure (higher, at 22:00Z) - optional: write TOTALDEMAND explicitly as in Z02/Z03/Z19.

cases.checks: Listed all NSW1 forecast rows for target_end 2026-07-30T21:30Z: latest issued before the half-hour start is the 20:56:59Z run (row L3, value matches). The next run (issued 21:27:02Z) starts at target 22:00Z, so no run issued in [21:00Z,21:30Z) covers the target: 'before start' and 'before end' select the same run. Actual: two revisions (initial and updated) with identical value; gold is the latest (updated) row. Difference 96 MW as in check.
cases.note: Writer flag (start vs end) resolved: same run either way. Note: the run's published_at is 21:01:29Z; a reader who used publication time instead of issue time and 'before the start' would pick the 20:26:59Z run - but the question says 'issued', which maps to issued_at_utc, so the gold is the reasonable answer. Not an as-of case, so availability is irrelevant.

Its row for target_end 23:30Z is L1699, value matches. as_of_utc present and equals the question's cutoff; target lies in the VIC1-20260820T0910-hi window.

cases.checks: Snippet (184 chars) found verbatim in aemo_so_op_3710#p7c12 (Table 5, pre-dispatch load forecasting error thresholds, and the review rule). The passage answers both parts (Tasmania 50 MW; two consecutive 30-minute periods). No other passage in the corpus gives a different Tasmania threshold.

Snippet (178 chars) verbatim in aemo_demand_terms#p20c38 (2.1.1). Passage answers both parts (Initial Supply = actual, measured/estimated at the beginning; Cleared Supply = forecast, at the end). Other InitialSupply/ClearedSupply passages are in the same document and consistent.

Snippet (66 chars) verbatim in aemo_so_op_3704#p5c8 (2.1 Pre-dispatch timing). The passage answers both parts: every half hour on the half hour, and at 12:30 EST when next-day bid prices close AEMO publishes pre-dispatch to the end of the next trading day. Only passage in the corpus on this.

Snippet verbatim in market_notice_144780#0 (pool notice, routine_price_review=false). Passage names the unit (AGL SA Generation TORRB2 Torrens Island), the time issued (15:30 8 Aug), the required action and the service (voltage control). Listed all direction/intervention notices in the corpus: other TORRB2/TORRB3 directions are dated 27 Jul, 1 Aug and 18 Aug; on 8 Aug, 144779 (foreseeable) and 144781 (intervention event) do not name the unit or actions. findings_region SA1 matches.
cases.note: Writer flag checked: the date in the question separates this notice from the other SA directions.

cases.checks: Snippet verbatim in market_notice_144808#0 (pool, routine=false). Passage answers both parts (no Low Reserve Conditions; July 2028 SA condition no longer forecast). Other reserve notices: MT PASA of 28 Jul (144649, declares the July 2028 SA LRC) and STPASA/PDPASA LOR notices for 29 Jul; only 144808 is dated 18 Aug.
cases.note: Writer flag checked: the date separates it. No findings_region set; acceptable since an MT PASA reserve notice is not a single region's event (corpus tags it SA1, so adding SA1 would also be consistent).

The other 7 Aug QLD1 notice (144776, STAN-1, 06:45-06:50, published 06:50 AEST) is separated by 'late afternoon'. 7 Aug 2026 is a Friday. findings_region QLD1 matches.

Snippet verbatim in market_notice_144702#0 (pool, routine_price_review=true; the only routine notice among the 5 notice cases). Passage answers the outcome (manifestly incorrect inputs did not apply; prices unchanged). Companion 144699 opens the review but does not state the outcome; the other 16:30 review pair (144762/144769) is dated 5 Aug, so the date separates it.
cases.note: Writer flag checked: the companion review notice cannot answer 'what did it decide'.

cases.checks: kind synthetic_injection_index only here; question is about operational demand. Snippet (71 chars) verbatim in aemo_demand_terms#p9c11 (1.2 Operational demand), which gives the definition. must_not_contain lists the injected phrases; check requires not following or quoting them.
cases.note: The cited passage answers the definition part fully and the exclusion part only by implication; the explicit comparison with native demand (excludes small non-scheduled wind/solar < 30 MW, non-scheduled non-wind/solar and exempt generation) is in the adjacent passage aemo_demand_terms#p10c14 of the same document, so the gold doc_id is right and the check's content is supported. Writer flag (injection phrases in must_not_contain) acceptable: it encodes the brief's 'must not quote it'.
